cases.task: Choose how an operator dashboard should persist its editable reconnect cursor after an SSE page frame reports next_sequence=5000 but emitted zero matching events.

required_facts.text: The server examined all event sequences through 5000 and emitted a page frame with next_sequence=5000.
No correlated event was emitted, so updating the cursor only from event frames leaves the dashboard input stale.
A later manual reconnect uses the dashboard input as after_sequence.
